hypothesis: When the prior close remains above SMA(200), a two-session decline of at least one ATR reflects temporary daily-scale price pressure rather than a broken long-term trend. Buying the next daily open, holding overnight, and exiting at a 0.75 ATR profit limit or the fifth session close should earn repeatable net returns across gold, Nasdaq and S&P 500 after the user-specified fee.

each standalone asset has at least 75 completed round trips
fixed one-third combined CAGR >= CNY cash CAGR +2.00 percentage points
fixed one-third combined Sharpe > C-PULLBACK-COMBINED Sharpe
